description: Day-count conventions and accrued interest for bonds, loans and swaps: days and year fraction between two dates under ACT/360, ACT/365F, ACT/ACT ISDA, NL/365, 30/360 (ISDA bond basis), 30/360 US (SIA end-of-February rules), 30E/360 and 30E/360 ISDA, with simple interest on a principal; or, for a fixed-coupon bond, the coupon schedule around a settlement date (previous / next coupon, end-of-month rule), accrued days and accrued interest per face amount, including ACT/ACT ICMA (Treasuries). Matches QuantLib. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/day-count

maturity.description: coupon: maturity date; between: termination date for 30E/360 ISDA

ratePct.description: between: annual simple rate for the interest amount; coupon: coupon rate
